title: What's New in Manufacturing: Reverse Production Order Transactions (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Overview of reverse production order transactions
Demo setup: finished production order issues
Handling subcontracting reversal and work in progress
Finishing orders without output and ledger entries

features.name: Revert output or consumption transactions
features.description: Capability to reverse output or consumption transactions in production orders, including returning unused raw materials back to warehouse and correcting mistakes in capacity ledger entries.

features.name: Reopen finished production orders
features.description: Ability to reopen finished production orders to make necessary adjustments after discovering mistakes, then finish the order again.

features.name: Reverse production order transaction action
features.description: Action that reverses production order transactions by generating a transaction with negative quantity and populating all relevant fields.

features.name: Undo receipt for subcontracting orders
features.description: Ability to undo receipt of purchase orders linked to production orders with subcontracting operations to revert output.
caveats: consumption remains unchanged and must be canceled manually

features.name: Finish production orders without output
features.description: Ability to finish production orders that have capacity or component consumption but no output, with work in progress amounts written off.
